title: Webhook Triggers Settings
description: Trigger external webhooks from YouTrack events. Webhook endpoints, the events each one subscribes to, and a per-endpoint signing token are configured through the Webhooks settings widget on the project's Apps page.

webhooksJson.title: Webhooks
webhooksJson.description: JSON-encoded list of webhook endpoints, each with a stable id, URL, and subscribed events. Signing tokens are NOT stored here — they live in the write-only `webhookSecrets` setting, keyed by endpoint id. Managed by the Webhooks settings widget; the YouTrack settings schema only allows entity-backed arrays, so this non-secret structured list is stored as a JSON string.

webhookSecrets.title: Webhook signing tokens
webhookSecrets.description: Per-endpoint signing tokens, keyed by the webhook id from `webhooksJson`. Stored as a write-only secret map: values are masked on read and merged per-key on write, so a token cannot be read back after it is saved, and re-saving without re-typing keeps the stored value.

headerName.title: Header name
headerName.description: The HTTP header name that carries each endpoint's signing token in outgoing requests.
